question.problem: If ${\int }_{C}z\,\text{d}x+x\,\text{d}y+y\,\text{d}z$ is equivalent to ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r$ for some piecewise smooth curve $C,$ then $F(x,y,z)=$
question.worked_solution:
Given a piecewise-smooth path $C$ and a vector field 

$$
F(x,y,z)=P(x,y,z)\,i+Q(x,y,z)\,j+R(x,y,z)\,k
$$

defined on $C,$ we have

$$
{\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r={\int }_{C}P\,\text{d}x+Q\,\text{d}y+R\,\text{d}z
$$

In our case, $P=z,Q=x,R=y.$ Therefore

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{C}(z\,i+x\,j+y\,k)\cdot \text{d}r & ={\int }_{C}z\,\text{d}x+x\,\text{d}y+y\,\text{d}z.\end{aligned}
$$

So, $F=z\,i+x\,j+y\,k.$
